text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Gentildonna! Gentildonna is 
out in front!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...!! Uuuuugh... Aaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the grueling path testing the 
maidens! Gracefully breaking through to 
cross the line in first is...! It's 
Gentildonna!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What formidable strength! A flawless 
redemption for the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohhh...!?)

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Holy crap...! S... so strong!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strategy tailored to her previous self 
was indeed unnecessary. She overpowered 
everything with overwhelming force... and 
showed what true strength is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To adapt to any conditions, draw out one's 
power at will, and secure certain 
victory... That is the mark of true 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Finally, it's become something reasonable.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on me. Yes, hold your 
breath... and gaze in awe.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The one standing before you all is no 
ordinary "winner," you know.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Now then, let us proceed even further.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The Shuka Sho... I will go and claim the 
crown that belongs to me."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You worked so hard too, Verxina!! Great 
job!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...! I... did a good job...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying... I did well to hold my 
own against someone like her?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —...Tch, what a complete humiliation...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No... no! That's why I couldn't afford to 
lose...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The title of Queen of the Oaks! I 
shouldn't have let it slip away...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Because... this race is the most—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I won't yield. Not at the very end...! 
The Shuka Sho—will be MINE!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. Shall we hear what you 
have to say?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You've had plenty of time to think. Now 
then, let's hear your praise for the 
victor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brought back to reality, I'm startled. I 
was so caught up in the excitement of 
watching such a splendid victory that I 
hadn't thought of anything else...!
choice_data_list:
Y-You really showed your strength, didn't 
you!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Just that much? Even so, you're missing 
the point."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You haven't seen the full outline of my 
power just yet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Once the summer passes, perhaps you too 
will see the full picture.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume grow by leaps and bounds over 
the summer. For that reason, Tracen 
Academy held a summer training camp aimed 
at improving their abilities.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is a truly precious opportunity to aim 
for even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you will prepare something from 
your finest selection, yes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel the pressure radiating from 
Gentildonna even more than usual. With 
each passing night, she grows stronger. 
Her extraordinary speed makes me—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, how about it? You're going to push 
me to greater heights, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Ah, to heights beyond your imagination
Yeah, to heights beyond your imagination.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ... You really said it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I am not the only one who needs to grow 
this summer. I expect you to redouble your 
efforts as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—For the day I shall demonstrate my true 
strength. Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in order to finish with a flourish 
at the final crown of the Tiara line, the 
Shuka Sho... we will push the training 
intensity even higher.
